newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn updates schedule for Feb 8 G7 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Bonn updates schedule for Feb 8 G7 meeting.

text.p: The German finance ministry released an updated programme for the meeting of Group of Seven finance ministers and central bank heads scheduled for February 8 in Berlin (all times GMT).
The main change from an earlier provisional schedule is that the final news conferences have been pulled forward from 1615 GMT. Final details will be released on Saturday.
0800 German Finance Minister Theo Waigel and Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer hold breakfast briefing
1045 Welcome by German Finance Minister Theo Waigel
at the meeting venue, the Kronprinzenpalais
1515 News conferences by German and other delegations
